_readme: Prop-firm rule templates for the Copilot. Firms change rules often: every plan is marked verified=false until you check it against the firm's help center (source) and set verified=true with the date. The user's own configured account on the Prop desk is always the source of truth for numbers.

topstep.name: Topstep
general: Trading must be flat by the firm's session cut-off (historically 3:10 pm CT / 4:10 pm ET) on futures.
Consistency target on the evaluation: the best day should stay under about 50% of the profit target.
Check the current news-trading and automation policy in the help center before trading around major releases.

apex.name: Apex Trader Funding
general: Evaluation drawdown has historically trailed intraday on unrealized highs: open profits raise the threshold.
Funded (PA) accounts carry consistency and payout rules; check the current version.
Positions must be closed before the daily session cut-off.

takeprofittrader.name: Take Profit Trader
general: End-of-day trailing drawdown on the test; consistency rule on the best day.
Check news-trading restrictions for the funded (PRO) stage.

myfundedfutures.name: MyFundedFutures
general: End-of-day trailing drawdown on most plans; consistency applies on some plans.
Several plan families exist (e.g. starter / expert); match your exact plan.

ftmo.name: FTMO
general: FX/CFD firm: limits are a static maximum loss and a daily loss measured from the day's starting equity.
Contract sizing on futures does not apply; use the % rules on the platform's lot sizes.
